AC10 evidence — `make verify` has now RUN to completion and exited 0. The earlier
comment saying it was "queued behind another verify on this host" was written before the
run started and is superseded by this one.

Run: worktree `.rebar/worktrees/perf-458e` at `fc022f64c09c864777bc93d9d9dde3a59b6a9128`
(the commit that merged as Gerrit change 3216). Log:
`.rebar/scratch/6a3fecbb-11456/make-verify.log`, completed 2026-11-02 02:05 PDT.

Every leg of the target, in order, with the line of the log that carries its verdict:

- `lint` (ruff check + format-check + the module-size, complexity and mechanism
  ratchets) -- `All checks passed!` (log line 2). The mechanism ratchet printed its
  admitted entries (log lines 26, 33) and exited 0; per AGENTS.md the exit code is the
  verdict, not the `new=` counter.
- `typecheck` -- `Success: no issues found in 750 source files` (log line 82).
- the bare-`pytest` import-convention guard -- `3 passed in 3.61s` (log line 85).
- `test`, default tier (`not integration and not external`) --
  `20252 passed, 27 skipped, 48 warnings in 2341.38s (0:39:01)` (log line 441).
- `test`, integration tier (`-m integration`) --
  `202 passed, 4 skipped in 202.79s (0:03:22)` (log line 449).

No failures, no errors, and no leg absent. The shell that ran it reported `EXIT=0`.

Independent of this log, the same tree was accepted by CI: Gerrit change 3216 carried
`Verified +1` alongside `LLM-Review +1` and was submitted at revision
`fc022f64c09c864777bc93d9d9dde3a59b6a9128`, which is now merged on `main`.
